title: Irish Barley Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting Italian-inspired casserole with a twist of Irish flair. Velvety and rich, it's perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Irish Velvety
ingredients.notes: chopped, 1 cup of which is the velvety sauce, 1 cup other chopped ingredients

instructions: Cook the barley according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat the olive oil and sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the Irish Velvety mixture and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, salt, and black pepper.
Combine the cooked barley, the pan mixture, and the mozzarella cheese in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Transfer the dish to the oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh basil.
Let the casserole rest for 10 minutes before serving.
